name: Deck Sweeper Stunning Blaster
description: The Deck Sweeper Stunning Blaster was a stun blaster manufactured by Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc. during the Galactic Civil War. Based on BlasTech Industries' Firespray DL-87 stun rifle, the Deck Sweeper only fired on the stun setting and had no lethal option. The Deck Sweeper was designed to stun a large number of targets at once; the wide barrel at the front of the weapon fired in a forty-five degree arc with a range up to ten meters.

data.name: Deck Sweeper Stunning Blaster
data.purpose: Close-range stunning of large numbers of targets at once
